_note: Local corrections layered on the SMC data by wall label. null removes a key.

Yellow Crag (East Wall).note: The routes are clear of the tide, though a big tide or swell can affect the way in.

Crazy Band Walls and The Shag’s Hole (Wa.seep_note: Does not seep badly; dries out for long periods every year (developers' notes, 2020)

Crazy Band Walls and The Shag’s Hole (Cr.seep_note: Bad seepage, worst at the left end; usually wet until May, with some holds staying wet beyond that (developers' notes, 2020)

Buchan Walls.seep_note: One corner sometimes carries a wet streak (developers' notes, 2024)

Logie Head (Pinnacle).note: The routes climb the pinnacle's western side, so it is scored as NW.

Earnsheugh (Far Wall).note: Faces north-west across the bay, unlike the rest of the crag.

Alligator Ridge (North Wall).note: The north side of the ridge, so it faces N, not S.

Altens Haven (Humpback Gulch).note: The sea covers the foot of some routes when the tide is in.

The Long Slough (Long Slough Pinnacle).note: The pinnacle is reached over flat rocks that the tide covers.

South Cove (Red Hole – Cave Walls).note: Tucked out of the wind, and prone to damp and grease because of it.

Saviours Wall.note: Gets wet streaks, slow to dry because a cliff to the south keeps the sun off.
